note: Sulphonation scheme written as one overall reaction: aniline (drawn with a lone pair on N, which does not change the SMILES) --H2SO4--> Anilinium hydrogensulphate, drawn as the salt +NH3 / HSO4- = [NH3+]c1ccccc1.[O-]S(=O)(=O)O --453-473 K--> Sulphanilic acid, which the last drawing links by a double-headed equilibrium arrow to its Zwitter ion [NH3+]c1ccc(S(=O)(=O)[O-])cc1. Only the named acid is given as the product; the intermediate salt and the zwitterion are recorded here because one record holds one reaction. 453-473 K is a condition with no SMILES form.
